mission_result: Executable recursive Planner contract: compile one immutable durable snapshot into a new generation bundle and derived worker frontier, preserving Steward integration and authority separation. Prove N->N+1->N+2 in repository code first; unattended invocation belongs to the separate event-loop workstream.

current_truth.implication: More workers over a finite manual queue proves parallelism, not recursive compounding.

input_contract.snapshot_rule: One invocation uses one immutable source-head/cutoff; later evidence waits for the next invocation.

algorithm: SNAPSHOT current head, stage gates, frontier, owner/authority/privacy graph and durable evidence.
VALIDATE lineage; unresolved source identity is parked, never guessed.

NORMALIZE each source into a planning atom carrying source refs, project/root, semantic target, problem signature, desired output, dependencies, owner candidates, privacy, write scope, critic requirement, falsification target and authority label.

DERIVE intents: unconsumed material RETURN -> VERIFY/INTEGRATE intent unless already covered; consumed Steward decision with unmet consequence -> direct work; valid proposal -> candidate intent; incident -> prevention/falsification intent; unresolved critic finding -> route-change/falsification intent; stale prerequisite -> recovery only when stale policy authorizes it.
HARD_DEDUP by exact canonical fingerprint. Exact match links new evidence to existing PREPARED/READY work instead of creating a duplicate.
SOFT_SIMILARITY never auto-merges. Similar text with different owner/scope/dependency/output/privacy/falsification remains separate or produces DEDUP_REVIEW_BLOCKED.
BUILD typed DAG from explicit hard dependencies and owner/authority/critic gates; cycles block affected nodes and emit cycle evidence.

INSERT at most one fresh strategic critic per generation trigger key when VERIFICATION_AND_CRITIC_CONTROL requires it; architecture/method or broad route promotion remains gated on required critic reconciliation.
DERIVE eligibility from PREPARED intent + satisfied dependencies + blockers + capability/tool/privacy + authority + claim/collision state. READY is a projection, not new authority.
PRIORITIZE eligible nodes lexicographically by priority class, dependency fanout descending, supported deadline, source age, opportunity_id. Priority never bypasses a hard gate.
EMIT immutable generation INPUT, disposition ledger, DAG, opportunity set, READY/BLOCKED projection, critic decision, next trigger and input/output digests.
IDEMPOTENCE: same input digest must produce same logical output set and no new logical opportunities.
REENTER only after relevant durable change: RETURN, Steward disposition, proposal, incident, critic return, blocker/dependency transition, stale transition, or goal/frontier delta.

dependency_rules.satisfied: terminal durable evidence plus owning Steward/integration rule marks the required output consumed/satisfied for dependent scope
dependency_rules.failed_or_boundary: dependent remains blocked unless explicit recovery/supersession path exists
dependency_rules.cycle: block all nodes in cycle; never delete an edge arbitrarily
dependency_rules.frontier: all PREPARED nodes with zero unsatisfied hard dependencies and no authority/privacy/tool/collision blocker

critic_rules.independence: route author cannot satisfy its own fresh strategic critic
critic_rules.reuse: matching active/returned fresh critic is linked instead of duplicated
critic_rules.handoff: findings enter next Planner input and must be adopted or rejected-with-reason when material
critic_rules.anti_recursion: critic RETURN alone does not recursively trigger critic-of-critic; new generation or distinct trigger required

output_contract.opportunity_shape: Conform to OPPORTUNITY_QUEUE_SPEC_V0; generated source state is PREPARED and READY/BLOCKED is derived.

authority_invariants: Planner never turns RETURN/proposal into Current, Human Accepted or Served.
Unconsumed RETURN may create verification/integration work but is not canonical product fact.
Steward consumption/integration stays explicit and append-only.
Generated work cannot widen unresolved owner/write/privacy/tool boundaries.
Shared/global owner work remains BLOCKED until authority is resolved.
Workers still need exclusive claim and STARTED-before-work.
Generation bundles are planning evidence/projections, not a second mutable authority plane.

stop_rules.STABLE_NO_NEW_WORK: same relevant input and no actionable post-dedup delta; do not emit empty generations
stop_rules.WAIT_DURABLE_EVENT: active work/external prerequisite exists; stop until durable transition
stop_rules.CRITIC_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ROUTE: required fresh critic missing for high-impact route; unrelated safe work may continue
stop_rules.STALLED_TWO_CYCLES: ensure critic trigger; if consumed critic yields no route change and digests stay stable, stop rather than generate ritual work

files.purpose: PREPARED set plus derived eligibility projection

shortest_implementation.invoke_now: Parent/dot or authorized workflow invokes compiler on durable change; human may still invoke platform compute but never designs N+1 tasks.

shortest_implementation.activation_boundary: Do not replace canary queues or advertise production /w until tests and remaining stale/claim/authority gates pass.
